verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents an official CLI with a dedicated CLI reference. Its docs say API keys work with the CLI, and an official GitHub Action integrates the CLI into CI pipelines, which supports scripted, automation-friendly use. missing for 10: detail on CLI command coverage (e.g., deploy/sandbox management commands), AI-native affordances such as machine-readable output or agent-driven use, independent or hands-on corroboration.
